transcript.text: Hello everyone. As you know, we're here to discuss the proposed peer repair circle for the product-operations team. Before I can approve the program and its operating terms, I need to hold our standard team check-in to hear operational concerns and policy requirements. I'll be using our round-robin format, so Darius, Mei, and Rafael — I'll need each of you to submit one concise formal record item about your relevant concern or requirement. I won't finalize the terms until all three items have been accepted. Let's get started — who'd like to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I want to submit my formal record item. My concern is about the proposed facilitator: I directly observed Lee interrupting and dismissing colleagues in three recent repair discussions. I believe participants will not speak freely if Lee facilitates, and I have not put these observations in a formal feedback record until now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'd like to submit my formal record item. My concern is about scheduling: I have a standing caregiving commitment on Wednesday evenings, so I can only attend reliably on Tuesdays from 16:00 to 17:00. I've already communicated this to the program organizer as the time I can sustain for the full trial. I'd like the operating terms to specify Tuesday 16:00–17:00 as the meeting time so the circle is accessible to me throughout the trial period.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I'd like to submit my formal record item. People Operations policy requires three things for this program: participation must be opt-in, circle disclosures are prohibited from being used in performance evaluations, and the initial trial is limited to exactly six weeks. The draft plan was circulated before I completed this policy check, so these requirements need to be reflected in the operating terms.
transcript.speaker: A4
